blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Text-driven human motion editing aims to realize a requested change while preserving compatible source content. Existing diffusion editors rely largely on learned conditioning for preservation of the unedited part, yet their outputs can lose temporal detail as denoising proceeds. We propose the Source-Preserving Denoising framework (SuperMotion) , which explicitly reuses the source at each reverse step for source preservation. We first align the source motion to the output timeline and predict a preservation gate that controls reuse across frames and feature dimensions. A clean-space source anchor then utilizes the learned preservation gate to blend the predicted clean motion with the aligned source and passes the corrected estimate directly to the sampling posterior. Because the aligned source is a realized motion rather than a regression output, the anchor injects sample-level temporal detail that a reconstruction-trained denoiser tends to smooth away. To learn effective source reuse, we supervise the anchored estimate against the editing target and match its second temporal differences through a temporal high-frequency loss. These objectives require no explicit edit masks. Extensive experiments show that SuperMotion improves editing accuracy, reaching 33.20% full-pool R@1 on MotionFix, while reducing temporal-detail attenuation and preserving motion dynamics as it realizes the requested changes. Ablations confirm that the learned preservation gate is responsible for the gain and that it reuses the source to retain the unedited content properly.
blocks.zh: 由文字驱动的人类运动编辑旨在实现请求的修改,同时保留相容的源内容. 现有的传播编辑主要依靠学到的知识来保存未经编辑的部分,但其产出可能会因为去名化而失去时间细节。 我们建议采用源保活度框架(SuperMotion),明确将源保活度在每一反向步骤回用. 我们首先将源动与输出时间同步,并预测一个控制跨帧和特征维度再利用的保存门. 清洁空间源锚再利用所学的保存门将预测的清洁运动与对接源相混合,并将经更正的估计直接传递给取样后方。 由于对接源是已实现的运动而不是回归输出,锚会注入样本级的时间细节,即重建所训练出能平缓的去向. 为了了解有效的源再利用,我们对照编辑目标监督定位估计数,并通过时间高频损失来匹配其第二次时间差异。 这些目标不需要明确的编辑口罩。 广泛的实验表明"超级运动"提高了编辑精度,在MotionFix上达到33.20%的全集R@1,同时在意识到所请求的修改时减少时间-细节的减弱并保留运动动态. 拆分确认所学保存门对收益负责,并重新使用源头以正确保留未经编辑的内容.

blocks.en: Text-driven human motion editing modifies an existing movement according to a textual instruction. A request such as “straighten knees” specifies a change while preserving other aspects of the source movement (Figure 1 ). A successful edit must therefore balance instruction compliance with preservation of compatible source content. This balance requires more than copying a predefined region. Source and reference target motions may differ in duration, coordination, and execution, so content that should be retained cannot be preserved exactly, but only approximately. The editor must determine how to use the source while accommodating the requested change.
blocks.zh: 由文本驱动的人类运动编辑根据文本指令修改了已经存在的运动. “直膝盖”等请求在保留源动的其他方面的同时,规定了变化(图1)。 因此,成功的编辑必须兼顾遵守指令和保持兼容源内容。 这种平衡需要的不仅仅是复制一个预先定义的区域. 来源和参考目标动议在持续时间、协调和执行方面可能有所不同,因此,应保留的内容不能完全保留,只能保留大约。 编辑器必须确定如何使用源,同时满足请求的更改.

blocks.en: Advances in text-conditioned motion generation provide a foundation for motion editing ( Petrovich et al., 2022 ; Tevet et al., 2022b ; Zhang et al., 2024 ; Guo et al., 2024 ) . Existing editors build on these models by improving how they use the source motion and instruction, learning motion similarity, and introducing objectives for editing body parts and preserving source content ( Athanasiou et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Guo et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Shi et al., 2026 ) . These methods can produce the requested action, but the resulting movement may be too subdued or too exaggerated compared with the reference target. Retrieval scores measure how well the generated motion matches the target in a learned representation, but do not directly measure these differences in movement. We therefore examine how temporal detail changes in the generated motion and throughout denoising.
blocks.zh: 文本条件运动生成的进步为运动编辑提供了基础(Petrovich等,2022;Tevet等,2022b;Zhang等,2024;Guo等,2024.). 现有编辑人员利用这些模式,改进了他们如何使用源动和指令,学习运动相似性,并引入了编辑机身部件和维护源内容的目标(Athanasiou等,2024;Li等,2025;Guo等,2025;Yang等,2025;Shi等,2026)。 这些方法可以产生所请求的动作,但与参考目标相比,由此产生的运动可能过于被抑制或过于夸大. 检索分数衡量所生成的运动在所学表现中与目标匹配的程度,但不直接衡量运动中的这些差异. 因此,我们审查产生运动的时间细节如何变化以及整个发号施令过程。

blocks.en:
Concretely, we define a detail ratio : the magnitude of second-order temporal differences of the running clean-motion estimate x ^ 0 \hat{x}_{0} at a given reverse step, normalized by the same statistic computed on the ground-truth target. A well-calibrated reverse process should drive this ratio toward 1 × 1\times and hold it there. Figure 2 shows that prior diffusion editors behave otherwise: the median ratio decreases along the reverse trajectory, crosses 1 × 1\times , and keeps falling, reaching 0.33 × 0.33\times for TMED ( Athanasiou et al., 2024 ) , 0.66 × 0.66\times for OmniME ( Shi et al., 2026 ) , and 0.71 × 0.71\times for SimMotionEdit ( Li et al., 2025 ) . The decline concentrates in the final low-noise steps, where the estimate already matches the target detail level and further denoising suppresses local temporal variation instead of refining it.
A denoiser trained with a reconstruction objective approximates a posterior mean ( Efron, 2011 ) , and such distortion-optimal estimates are necessarily smoother than individual samples ( Blau and Michaeli, 2018 ) . The effect is especially costly in motion editing. The content that should be preserved already exists in the source, but regenerating the sequence from noise forces the model to resynthesize it, after which it is pulled toward the mean.

blocks.en: These observations motivate explicit control over source reuse during denoising. In frameworks that reconstruct the target from noise, source conditioning provides information about the input motion, but retaining its content still depends on the denoiser’s predictions ( Athanasiou et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025 ) . The source could also provide a clean signal against which those predictions are adjusted at each reverse step. Related ideas appear in diffusion-based image editing and inpainting, where spatial masks or known regions guide the preservation of existing content ( Avrahami et al., 2022 ; Lugmayr et al., 2022 ; Couairon et al., 2022 ) . Applying this principle to motion editing requires accounting for differences between the source and target sequences. Because no preservation mask is supplied, the model must learn how strongly to reuse the aligned source while allowing the instruction to change the movement.
blocks.zh: 这些观察促使人们明确控制源的再利用。 在从噪音中重建目标的框架里,源调节提供了输入运动的信息,但保留其内容仍然取决于denoiser的预测(Athanasiou等,2024;Li等,2025)。 源头还可以提供一个干净的信号,在每一反向步骤上对这些预测进行调整。 相关想法出现在以传播为基础的图像编辑和油漆中,空间口罩或已知区域指导现有内容的保存(Avrahami等,2022;Lugmayr等,2022;Couairon等,2022.). 将这一原则应用于运动编辑需要考虑源与目标序列之间的差异. 由于没有提供保存口罩,模型必须学会如何强烈地再利用对齐源,同时允许指令改变运动.

blocks.en:
We introduce the S o u rce- P res er ving Denoising framework (SuperMotion) to learn this balance within the reverse process. Its central component, a Clean-Space Source Anchor , blends the current clean-motion estimate with a temporally aligned source through a learned Source Preservation Gate . The gate assigns a reuse weight to each frame and feature dimension at each denoising step. Applied after classifier-free guidance and clean-motion reconstruction, the anchor produces the estimate used directly by the sampling posterior.
This placement gives the gate a consistent interpretation as a convex blending weight and avoids the inverse noise-scale factor required to express the same clean-motion correction in velocity space.
Supervision against the editing target trains the gate to adjust source reuse without an explicit edit mask. We train SuperMotion with a source-anchor loss that learns source reuse from the editing target and a temporal high-frequency loss that matches second temporal differences.

blocks.en: We conduct extensive experiments to evaluate our method. The results show that SuperMotion improves instruction compliance while reducing temporal-detail attenuation. Ablation studies show that supervising the anchored prediction against the editing target is critical to learning effective source reuse. Our contributions are threefold. 1. We identify temporal-detail attenuation as a systematic failure of diffusion motion editors. Their clean-motion estimates lose second-order temporal variation during late denoising, and several published editors score below a copy-source baseline. 2. We propose SuperMotion, which reuses a temporally aligned source at each reverse step through a learned per-frame, per-dimension gate on the clean-motion estimate, trained from the editing target without edit masks. 3. SuperMotion reaches 79.17% batch R@1 and 33.20% full-pool R@1 on MotionFix and 46.88% batch R@1 on STANCE Adjustment, surpassing the strongest prior editor by 1.88, 1.18, and 3.13 points. It restores the detail ratio to 1.035, against 0.66 to 0.71 for prior editors, confirming that the learned preservation gate recovers high-frequency detail from the source motion.
blocks.zh: 我们进行广泛的实验来评估我们的方法。 结果显示"超级运动"改善了指令的遵守,同时减少了时间细节的减弱. 校正研究表明,对照编辑目标监督锁定的预测对于学习有效的源再利用至关重要。 我们的贡献有三个方面。 1. 我们确定时间-细节衰减是扩散运动编辑器的系统故障。 他们的清洁运动估计在后期去诺时会失去二等时间变化,一些已出版的编辑得分低于复制源基线. 2. 我们提出Super Motion,它通过一个在清洁运动估计上学得的每帧分层闸门,在每一反向步骤上重新使用一个按时间排列的源头,从编辑目标中培训而无需编辑口罩。 3. Super Motion在MotionFix上达到79.17%的批R@1和33.20%的全集R@1,在STANCE调整上达到46.88%的批R@1,以1.88分,1.18分和3.13分超过前最强编辑. 它将细节比恢复到1.035,而前作编辑者为0.66比0.71,确认所学的保存门从源动中恢复出高频细节.

blocks.en:
Human Motion Generation. Text-driven human motion generation has progressed through
continuous latent modeling, diffusion-based synthesis, and
discrete motion modeling.
Guo et al. ( Guo et al., 2022 ) investigate diverse
text-conditioned motion synthesis and introduce HumanML3D,
supporting subsequent advances in language-driven animation.
TEMOS ( Petrovich et al., 2022 ) learns compatible text and motion
distributions through variational training, while
MotionCLIP ( Tevet et al., 2022a ) aligns motion representations
with the CLIP embedding space.
Diffusion-based methods, including MDM ( Tevet et al., 2022b ) ,
MotionDiffuse ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) , and FLAME ( Kim et al., 2023 ) ,
generate motions through text-conditioned iterative denoising.
MLD ( Chen et al., 2023 ) instead performs diffusion in a compact
latent space to reduce computational cost. Discrete motion representations provide an alternative to
continuous-space generation.
T2M-GPT ( Zhang et al., 2023a ) combines vector quantization with
autoregressive token prediction, while
MotionGPT ( Jiang et al., 2023 ) models motion and language within
a unified token-based framework.
MoMask ( Guo et al., 2024 ) and MMM ( Pinyoanuntapong et al., 2024 ) adopt masked motion
modeling, enabling iterative token reconstruction and flexible
generation.
Beyond global text conditioning, FineMoGen ( Zhang et al., 2023b ) introduces fine-grained spatio-temporal control, and
MaskControl ( Pinyoanuntapong et al., 2025 ) incorporates spatial constraints
into masked motion generation.
Together, these approaches improve the diversity, efficiency,
and controllability of human motion synthesis.

blocks.en:
Human Motion Editing. Human motion editing modifies an existing sequence while
retaining content compatible with the requested change.
Early generative approaches enable editing through semantic
latent manipulation or constrained reconstruction.
MotionCLIP ( Tevet et al., 2022a ) supports editing in a
language-aligned latent space, while MDM ( Tevet et al., 2022b ) and
FLAME ( Kim et al., 2023 ) support motion completion and editing
through constrained diffusion.
MMM ( Pinyoanuntapong et al., 2024 ) reconstructs masked motion tokens, and
FineMoGen ( Zhang et al., 2023b ) supports fine-grained editing
through spatio-temporal descriptions.
These approaches establish useful editing capabilities,
although their control interfaces and supervision differ
from paired instruction-based editing. MotionFix ( Athanasiou et al., 2024 ) establishes a benchmark of
source–instruction–target triplets and introduces a
source-conditioned diffusion editor.
Subsequent work improves instruction alignment, motion
preservation, and editing versatility.
SimMotionEdit ( Li et al., 2025 ) jointly trains motion
editing and motion-similarity prediction, while
PartMotionEdit ( Yang et al., 2025 ) combines part-aware
modulation with part-level similarity supervision and
bidirectional text–motion interaction.
MotionReFit ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) expands editing supervision
through MotionCutMix and uses an autoregressive diffusion
model with a motion coordinator.
MotionLab ( Guo et al., 2025 ) unifies generation and editing
through a motion–condition–motion formulation based on
rectified flows.
OmniME ( Shi et al., 2026 ) combines intermediate-feature,
preservation, and positive–negative semantic supervision.
Recent work further considers both spatial preservation
and temporal rhythm through non-uniform temporal
alignment ( Lin et al., 2026 ) .

SuperMotion uses a learned, feature-wise source anchor to modify

blocks.en: Given a source motion and an editing instruction, our goal is to generate a motion that realizes the requested change while retaining compatible source content. Our Source-Preserving Denoising (SuperMotion) makes source reuse an explicit operation inside the reverse process, applied to the clean-motion estimate at every step and controlled by a gate learned from the editing target alone.

blocks.en: The instruction typically changes only part of the source. Over the remaining frames and coordinates the target coincides with the source, so the underlying edit is close to an identity mapping. Diffusion editors nevertheless regenerate the full sequence from Gaussian noise with s s and c c used only as conditions, so every reverse step re-synthesizes coordinates that could have been copied. blocks.en: We evaluate on MotionFix ( Athanasiou et al., 2024 ) and STANCE Adjustment from OmniME ( Shi et al., 2026 ) . MotionFix provides 6,730 (source, instruction, target) triplets: 5,387 for training, 330 for validation, and 1,013 for testing, at 30 fps. STANCE is a separate 20 fps benchmark with 4,411 triplets.

blocks.en: We use a pretrained TMR encoder ( Petrovich et al., 2023 ) to rank reference target motions by their embedding similarity to each generated motion. We report R@1, R@2, R@3, and average rank for batch retrieval and full-pool retrieval as previous methods ( Athanasiou et al., 2024 ; Shi et al., 2026 ) . Higher recall and lower average rank indicate better performance.

blocks.en: We build on SimMotionEdit ( Li et al., 2025 ) , using a frozen CLIP ViT-L/14 text encoder and a 207-dimensional motion representation at 30 fps. We initialize SuperMotion from the trained backbone and jointly train the denoiser and preservation head using AdamW with a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} and a batch size of 128 on a single NVIDIA A100 GPU. We use velocity prediction with a squared-cosine noise schedule and 300 diffusion steps. At inference, both source and text guidance scales are set to 3.0, and source anchoring is applied after guidance at every reverse step.

blocks.en: Table 1 and Table 2 report quantitative comparisons. On MotionFix, our method ranks first on seven of eight metrics, with OmniME ( Shi et al., 2026 ) marginally ahead on FR@3 . A more informative reference is the copy source baseline, which returns the input unchanged and still reaches 74.79 % 74.79\% BR@1 . Most prior editors fall below it, indicating that regenerating the target from noise destroys more source content than the edit itself introduces. Only OmniME and our method exceed this baseline, and ours does so by the larger margin on both batch ( + 4.38 +4.38 ) and full-pool ( + 2.96 +2.96 ) R@1. On STANCE Adjustment, our method leads all batch-retrieval metrics and improves full-pool AvgR from 22.77 22.77 to 19.21 19.21 . FR@1 is lower than OmniME, while FR@3 is higher and full-pool AvgR is lower, indicating fewer severe ranking failures rather than more top-1 matches. Across the two benchmarks, SuperMotion is the only method that exceeds the copy-source baseline on every retrieval metric on both benchmarks.

blocks.en: Figure 4 presents qualitative comparisons on MotionFix. The first two examples assess instruction compliance. For move the hands slower , the baselines keep the arm moving at the source speed and leave its trajectory unchanged, whereas our result reduces the hand velocity while keeping the arm path and body configuration of the source. For spread legs less, look around and rapidly look behind you at the end , which combines a continuous adjustment with a terminal action, only our method produces both, with the final turn matching the ground-truth timing. The third example, “ move faster ”, instead probes source preservation. The instruction changes only the temporal profile, yet TMED and SimMotionEdit resynthesize the limb trajectories and drift from the source configuration. blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we analyze the denoising process of existing methods and identify the temporal-detail attenuation as a systematic failure of diffusion motion editors. We propose Source-Preserving Denoising, which makes source reuse an explicit operation at every reverse step by blending the clean-motion estimate toward the aligned source through a learned per-frame, per-dimension gate. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SuperMotion consistently outperforms state-of-the-art editors on both MotionFix and STANCE Adjustment. Ablations attribute the improvement to the learned preservation gate, which enables selective source reuse and preserves high-frequency temporal detail that competing methods attenuate.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们分析现有方法的去名过程,并确定时间-细节衰减是扩散运动编辑器的系统故障. 我们建议保留源分解,使源分解再利用在每一倒数阶段都成为一种明确的操作,办法是通过每方分解一帧的学习门,将清洁运动估计值与对接源相混合。 广泛的实验证明"超级运动"在"运动Fix"和"STANCE"调整上的表现始终优于最先进的编辑. 缺损将改进归因于已学会的保存门,它使有选择的来源可以再利用,并保留了高频时间细节,使相竞方法会减弱.

blocks.en: Appendix F Qualitative Results on STANCE Adjustment
blocks.zh: 附录F 定性 关于暂停调整的结果

blocks.en: Figure 7 shows results on STANCE Adjustment, where each instruction targets a specific limb or side. In the lower body runs to the other side , the baselines introduce a full-body reorientation or an airborne pose absent from the source, while our result redirects the lower body alone. In raise the other leg upward and bend the other arm , the baselines frequently act on the wrong limb or apply the change to both sides. Our method selects the intended one and leaves the remaining joints close to the source.
blocks.zh: 图7显示了STANCE调整的结果,其中每项指令都针对特定肢或侧. 在下体运行到另一侧,基线引入了全身重定向或空中姿势,而我们的结果则将下体单独转向. 在将另一条腿向上抬起并弯曲另一条手臂时,基线常常会错在四肢上行走,或者将变化应用到两侧。 我们的方法选择预定的,让剩下的关节靠近源头.
